title: Дух битвы [Перезапуск]: Небеса изолированного мира
alt: Battle Spirits [Re] Zekkai No Ku Battle Spirits [Re] 絶界の空
description: Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion. (Source: Crunchyroll)

en:
Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion.


(Source: Crunchyroll)
